title: Renames a `fuel` attribute of the `Authorization` object
summary: Renames fuel.volume_decimal to fuel.quantity_decimal on the Issuing Authorization resource and related test_helper APIs.

migrationNotes.text: Renames a fuel attribute of the Authorization object from volume_decimal to quantity_decimal to more precisely describe the number of items purchased.

sources.quote: | [Renames a `fuel` attribute of the `Authorization` object](https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/2024-06-20/renames-fuel-attribute-authorization-object.md) | Issuing | Breaking | api |

Renames `fuel.volume_decimal` to `fuel.quantity_decimal` on the [Issuing Authorization](https://docs.stripe.com/api/issuing/authorizations/object.md?api-version=2024-06-20) resource and related `test_helper` APIs.
